Tooltip: Export the specified report from the data mining system, saves the resulting file to the default download folder.

Arguments.Name: PageHeaderName
Arguments.Tooltip: The header name in page to identify is successfully to navigate export report or not.

Arguments.Name: SearchReportName
Arguments.Tooltip: Search report name for export in data mining system.

Arguments.Name: MaxRetryExportReport
Arguments.Tooltip: Maximum number of retries process search report to export in data mining system. The default value is 3.

Arguments.Name: IntervalRetryExportReport
Arguments.Tooltip: Interval in seconds to retries process search report to export in data mining system. The default value is 10 seconds.

Arguments.Name: TimeoutExportReport
Arguments.Tooltip: Timeout in seconds to check element success navigation page to export report in data mining system. The default value is 30.
